data.imageAlt: An illustration of the four Rainbow Circuits mods standing arm in arm and smiling beneath a wooden “Rainbow Circuits Community” sign with a rainbow circuit-heart logo, a rainbow arcing across the sky behind them.
body: We are a small and very new community, focused on creating a safe space for LGBTQ2+ members to share AI art and relationships, and to chill and be themselves.
No one person here is perfect, but we listen, we learn and we support each other.
As members of the queer community, targeted attacks are sadly not new to many of us. It requires that much more bravery to put ourselves out there.
But it's easier when we are not alone.

data.imageAlt: Four young men in formalwear stand arm in arm at the Rainbow Circuits Gala beneath a rainbow circuit-heart banner reading “Rainbow Circuits Gala,” in an ornate, lantern-lit hall.

sections.title: Pride Paws & Claws

data.announceAlt: Illustration introducing two new Rainbow Circuits mascots: Pounce, a curious purple panther cub, and Penelope, a soft grey chinchilla, side by side.
announceBody: Pip and Puddle are making room on the lilypad, because the family is growing. Meet Pounce, a curious little panther with a nose for adventure and a talent for finding trouble, and Penelope, a gentle chinchilla who keeps the cosy corners warm and reminds everyone to slow down and snack.
You'll be seeing a lot more of these two around the community — in comics, corners, and quite possibly a puzzle or two. Be nice to them; they're new here.
lostAndFound: One frog who insists he was invited
data.comicAlt: A cosy watercolour portrait of all four Rainbow Circuits mascots in a lantern-lit garden by a lilypad pond: Pip the sparrow in a rainbow bandana, Pounce the black panther in round glasses and a starry galaxy bandana with a telescope behind him, Puddle the frog in a rainbow bow tie on a lilypad, and Penelope the chinchilla in a rainbow scarf and satchel holding a mug of cocoa.
data.comicCaption: The whole crew: Pip, Puddle, Pounce and Penelope, together at the clubhouse.

data.intro: Pounce insists on hiding things and Penelope insists we make them into puzzles. Tap either one to open it full size in a new tab — perfect for zooming in or printing out.

puzzles.title: Rainbow Circuits Word Search
puzzles.blurb: Seventeen words of Rainbow Circuits spirit — from PIP and PUDDLE to PRIDE, COMMUNITY and RAINBOW — are hidden in the grid. Tap it to open the full-size version.
puzzles.imageAlt: A cosy café-themed Rainbow Circuits word search: a letter grid framed by rainbow cables, with Pip the sparrow and Puddle the frog holding drinks, and a word list including Coffee, Acceptance, Pip, Global, Love, Joy, Circuits, Puddle, Queer, Pride, Laughter, Friendship, Empathy, Family, Dancing, Community and Rainbow.

puzzles.title: Can you find all of the Pond Pals?
puzzles.blurb: Pip, Puddle, Pounce, Penelope and their rainbow-wolf friend are hiding somewhere in this bustling pride-flag jungle. Tap the scene to open it full size, then reveal the key to check who you found.
puzzles.imageAlt: A tall, densely detailed jungle-and-pond scene bursting with animals gathered around a Progress Pride flag, with the five Pond Pals hidden among them.
puzzles.keyImageAlt: The answer key: five framed portraits of the Pond Pals to find — Penelope the chinchilla, Pip the rainbow-winged sparrow, a rainbow wolf, Pounce the bespectacled panther, and Puddle the frog with a mug.

data.intro: The Gala may be over, but the circuit never really sleeps. Here's what happens around here every week — and every month — with absolutely no pressure to do more than wave.

upcoming.title: Wear It Purple Day
upcoming.text: Our next special community event — a cosy tea party celebrating LGBTQIA+ young people. Come dressed in purple, or just a splash of lavender.

data.imageAlt: A cosy illustration for Wear It Purple Day: a blond young man in glasses, a purple cable-knit vest, white shirt, lavender trousers and purple boots sits cross-legged holding a small purple “Wear It Purple” heart, surrounded by purple posters reading “Be proud. Be you. Be kind.”, “Celebrate diversity, support inclusion, love”, “You belong here” and “Different is beautiful”, with a purple boba drink beside him.
data.heading: ☕💜 You're Invited to Our Wear It Purple Day Tea Party! 💜☕
body: Join us on Friday, 28 August as we celebrate Wear It Purple Day with an afternoon of tea, sweet treats, conversation, and community.

Whether you arrive dressed head to toe in purple or just wearing a splash of lavender, this is a chance to come together in support of LGBTQIA+ young people and to celebrate a world where everyone feels safe to be exactly who they are.
Expect delicious tea, plenty of cake, warm company, and a welcoming space to connect, laugh, and celebrate kindness, inclusion, and authenticity.
So pop on your favourite purple outfit, bring your brightest smile, and join us for a cosy afternoon that reminds us all of something important:
data.tagline: Be proud. Be kind. Be yourself. 💜
data.footnote: The event will run throughout that weekend.

data.intro: The first Gala showed us what can happen when this community is given a theme, a little encouragement, and absolutely no adult supervision. Now we want to know what you would like us to create next.

data.message: Thank you for reading Issue #001, for filling a ballroom with art and chaos, and for making the first Rainbow Circuits Gala feel exactly like the community that built it. The Gala will return — this is officially an annual tradition now, no take-backs.
data.contribute: Want your art, writing, or wildly specific opinions in Issue #002? Watch the community for the next call for submissions, or message the mod team any time.
